title: [daily-reply-dust] dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey: characterization test for hashed file key layout and guards
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey in src/daily-reply-dust.ts: hashed file keys
- dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey("2026-10-13", "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef") is "permanent/daily-reply-dust/2026-10-13/grouped-daily-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.rdust"
- dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey("2026-10-13", "0123456789ABCDEF0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef") throws INVALID_REPLY_SHA256
- dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey("2026-10-13", "abc") throws INVALID_REPLY_SHA256
- dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey("2026-10-1", "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef") throws INVALID_SESSION_DATE

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey is only used round-trip through a store; its literal layout, the INVALID_REPLY_SHA256 guard (uppercase or short hex) and INVALID_SESSION_DATE are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS ef9778e (Workspace main 3670cd8, live 27-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with dailyReplyDustHashedFileKey stubbed); suite 598/598 with all thirteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
